column1: # Editorial categories for the suppressed list. Not Apple's: these are
# hand-written rules applied only to words the census found suppressed.
# Format: category<TAB>regex (anchored, case-insensitive). First match wins.
# Prefix patterns like "abort.*" are safe here because they only ever see
# suppressed words; "analysis" never reaches this file.
# Second pass, from reading the words the first pass left in "other".
